scope: Frontend source, browser bridge, wire declarations, generated preview and frontend QA only.

checks.wireTypes: Passed TypeScript 5.9.3 with strict, NodeNext and noEmit.
checks.javascriptSyntax: Passed node --check for edited JavaScript modules.
checks.receiptIdMutation: Replacing the random prefix with a fixed prefix caused the reopened-browser test to fail with the previous browser's receipt; restoring UUID passed.

browser.engine: Isolated Chromium headless shell through omowright
verified: Persisted user and assistant messages render after bootstrap.
The real acceptance host's completed calibration run restores history, tool records and model binding.
SSE/bootstrap failures preserve hosted mode and expose Retry connection.
Retry connection restores history after a real HTTP/SSE fixture interruption.
Rejected prompts restore the original composer draft and show an error.
Authored project, user, count and conversation fixtures are hidden before app initialization.
Mobile document scroll width equals the 390 CSS pixel viewport width.
browser.realHostRestartNote: The fixed bridge was loaded into the real host's cached HTML after closing its old bridge. The host must restart to serve the rebuilt cached assets normally.

limitations: The rendered contrast/reflow detector failed inside its renderer with a SyntaxError; no full WCAG AA result is claimed.
